_notes: All masses/costs are gameplay values tuned to NASA mission fact sheets for the 2026 Space Apps build. isp_s is vacuum specific impulse (s), thrust_n is vacuum thrust (N). power_w > 0 generates power, < 0 consumes it. 'art' maps to assets/art/art_manifest.json.

parts.name: Command Core
parts.desc: Standard command core. 6 attachment hardpoints, basic telemetry buffer.

parts.name: Deep-Space Command Core
parts.desc: Radiation-tolerant core with a 9-slot bus and deep-space telemetry buffer.

parts.name: Truss Ring
parts.desc: Adds 2 attachment slots. Cheap dry mass -- useful, but every kilogram costs Delta-V.

parts.name: Hull Panel
parts.desc: Bare structural tile. Bolts the stack together so parts can sit far from the core without floating free.

parts.name: Ablative Heatshield
parts.desc: Prevents burn-up during atmospheric entry and aerobraking. Heavy dry mass.

parts.name: Auxiliary Tank
parts.desc: Small propellant tank. 420 kg of usable propellant.

parts.name: Main Propellant Tank
parts.desc: Primary tank. 1000 kg of propellant; dominates wet mass and Delta-V.

parts.name: Bipropellant Engine
parts.desc: High-thrust hydrolox engine (Isp 450 s). Ideal for rapid capture burns.

parts.name: Xenon Ion Drive
parts.desc: Extreme fuel efficiency (Isp 3100 s), but 0.25 N of thrust needs megawatts of power.

parts.name: Photovoltaic Wing
parts.desc: 1200 W at 1 AU. Output falls off as 1/r^2 -- useless past the asteroid belt.

parts.name: Multi-Mission RTG
parts.desc: 300 W regardless of distance from the Sun. Heavy and expensive, but deep space demands it.

parts.name: Low-Gain Antenna
parts.desc: Omnidirectional link. Low bandwidth, but always points at Earth.

parts.name: High-Gain Dish
parts.desc: Parabolic dish for Deep Space Network downlink. Needs power and line-of-sight.

parts.name: Communications Relay Payload
parts.desc: The mission-critical lunar relay package. Required for the Lunar Relay contract.

parts.name: Imaging Spectrometer
parts.desc: Collects surface science points when powered inside the target's range.
